title: DWG/DXF 3D route and acceptance crosswalk
evidenceKind: primary-source web review across schemas, open-source codecs, and consumer documentation

method.evidenceRule: A peer's typed entity, raw payload, successful parse, or self-readback establishes only that route's syntax/carrier behavior. Geometry semantics and downstream application acceptance require separate evidence. ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte-layout questions.

evidence.route: DXF ACIS carrier versus history reference
evidence.observed: Autodesk's 3DSOLID reference identifies modeler version group 70, proprietary data in group 1, additional continuation data in group 3, and a separate soft-owner history handle in group 350. ezdxf documents SAT for R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013+ and offers raw ACIS inspection/export.
evidence.planUse: Keep ordered group-1/group-3 carrier bytes and group-350 history ownership separately observable. Use captured source version/profile rather than inferring ACIS semantics from the DXF entity shell.

evidence.route: Open-source DXF reader, author, and renderer boundaries
evidence.observed: ezdxf says ACIS creation requires an external library; its drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D rendering engine, projecting 3D entities into XY. IxMilia.Dxf exposes a typed Dxf3DSolid model and claims R10-R2014 coverage but warns that several typed entity outputs, including 3DSOLID, BODY, and REGION, may not be accepted by AutoCAD.
evidence.planUse: Admit these as exact-version syntax/carrier or 2D projection observers only. Require independent native application acceptance for interoperability claims; a typed entity or self-readback is not a solid pass.

evidence.route: DWG entity shell and modern AcDs backing store
evidence.observed: LibreDWG's manual distinguishes known entity types from documented test-coverage gaps. Open issue #1411 shows a modern R2013+ REGION surviving conversion while its associated AcDs ACIS geometry is lost. The issue provides a concrete failure shape, not format authority.
evidence.planUse: Preserve the existing exact object-key/payload association check and explicit accounting for every residual AcDs record. An entity count with empty/missing geometry is data loss.

evidence.observed: ACadSharp issue #1195 reports hundreds of omitted 3DSOLID/REGION entities, including definitions whose blocks contain only modeler records. On the review date, writer PR #1240 and prerequisite storage PR #1174 were both open.
evidence.planUse: Keep per-source-entity dispositions and block membership in the existing writer gate; test that INSERTs cannot conceal an emptied solid-only block. The peer issue is a risk pattern, not a libdxfrw finding.

evidence.observed: Official Draft DXF documentation lists different C++ and legacy importer subsets, identifies 3DFACE only in the legacy list, and says embedded ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read. DWG import delegates through an external converter and then the DXF importer.
evidence.planUse: Keep FreeCAD qualification specific to exact build, converter, importer, and explicit-entity subset. Treat ACIS solids as unsupported-consumer outcomes, not as codec success or failure.

implementationReadiness: Maintain five separate PAR-07/S8 outcome lanes: DXF ACIS carrier, DWG AcDs carrier, explicit 3D geometry, ACIS model semantics, and named downstream application outcome.
For DXF modeler writes, record entity identity, $ACADVER, group 70, ordered group 1/3 chunks, separate group-350 handle, strict readback, and explicit loss/refusal disposition.
For DWG modeler reads/writes, record entity handle/type and block owner, exact DataStorage key and payload hash, and disposition for every unmatched/opaque AcDs record.
Test explicit 3DFACE, 3D POLYLINE/PFACE, MESH, and supported surface families independently from ACIS-bearing entities; do not promote a generic 3D claim from any one entity family.
Use fast owning CTests and the existing LibreCAD compatibility target for local source slices; execute one pinned peer/native comparison only at the existing composed checkpoint.

If profile-matched samples, authorized tools, or an applicable native build are unavailable, record the precise NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED reason and self-unblock to local work. Do not add downloads, fixture files, dependencies, or full-suite runs for this research update.
limitations: This is a documentation/source review, not an executed peer comparison, native application test, or geometry-kernel qualification.
Mutable peer documentation and issue reports may change; pin exact versions and revisions before any future optional run.
No peer result in this review establishes libdxfrw conformance or ACIS/AcDs semantic support.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte-layout questions.
